subject: Strategic weeknote — wins, chokepoints, and decision lanes
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanguard Health <sales@vanguardhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic weeknote — wins, chokepoints, and decision lanes

Team — weekly focused readout below (concise). Planning note: QBR pack deadline is 2026-11-17; please flag items that need exec signoff by EOD 11/12.

Wins:
- Hosted API perf: rolled a kernel update to prod for rp-4 models; median p95 latency down 9% on our microbenchmarks. Ops validated no customer impact.
- Vanguard Health POC: initial inference trial passed our throughput SLAs on Dedicated; vendor (Vanguard) signed off on next-phase integration.
- Observability: launched token-level cost breakdown in Console for internal pilot (billing-team + 3 customers). Early feedback positive.

Chokepoints / Risks:
- QBR deck gap: we still lack a consolidated cost-savings narrative — need a short, customer-facing slide showing batching + caching impact with numbers (owner: Karthik).
- Dedicated capacity scheduling: two fleet nodes (us-west) are flagged for maintenance the week of 11/15 — could reduce canary capacity; request fallback plan.
- Security questionnaire: Vanguard requested additional SOC2 artifact (log-retention proof) — security is preparing but timeline is tight (ask below).

Asks / Decision lanes:
1) Karthik: please produce the cost-savings slide + 1-pager with assumptions by 11/10 EOD (needed for QBR rehearsal). Attachment: QBR-ask-tracker.xlsx (has current open asks).
2) Laura: approve contingency policy for canary fallback (allow temporary routing to eu-central for non-PHI traffic) or confirm alternative. Need decision by 11/11.
3) Marissa: own the Vanguard evidence response coordination — security will need a single contact for the audit artifacts. Can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?

Notes / quick status items:
- Action: I will consolidate inputs into the QBR draft (link below).
- Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcQBRDraft (draft deck).

Thanks — brief replies okay for read receipt.

--
Camila Reyes
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
[Attachment: QBR-ask-tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic weeknote — wins, chokepoints, and decision lanes

Camila — thanks for the concise beat. Quick responses inline.

> Chokepoints: Dedicated capacity scheduling maintenance
I approve the contingency to route non-PHI traffic to eu-central as a temporary measure, provided we add a one-line customer-facing note about potential latency for affected flows. (I'd like ops to quantify p95 impact in one slide.)

> Asks: decision by 11/11
Confirmed — I'll sign off on the fallback policy on 11/11 if we have the short p95 impact note.

Please mark anything that needs my signature in the QBR deck with the "SIGN-OFF" flag so I can find quickly.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic weeknote — wins, chokepoints, and decision lanes

Thanks Camila. I have a couple clarifying notes and a quick ask: 

1) Cost-savings slide: I can produce the slide but I need the baseline token distribution and one sample customer workload (preferably Vanguard's trial trace) to calculate realistic %-savings for batching + cache. Can Vanguard share a short trace (anonymized) or should Ops provide a representative sample?

2) Fleet nodes: Ops, please confirm whether maintenance windows can be moved by 48 hours or if we must execute as scheduled. Impact on canary capacity influences the slide messaging.

I attached a short report with current ops metrics that I'll reference in the slide.

-Karthik
[Attachment: QBR-ops-metrics.pdf]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanguard Health <sales@vanguardhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategic weeknote — wins, chokepoints, and decision lanes

Karthik / team — follow-ups and owners: 

- Baseline trace: Vanguard agreed to share an anonymized 48-hour trace for slide modeling. Vanguard (sales@vanguardhealth.com) — thank you; Marissa will coordinate secure transfer; please send to security@redwood.com and cc Marissa.

- Fleet maintenance: Ops confirms we have a 24-hour wiggle but not 48. I recommend we keep the window and use eu-central fallback for canaries (per Laura's approval). Ops will run a targeted p95 analysis and drop a single-slide summary into the deck by EOD 11/10. Owner: Camila / Ops.

- QBR timeline: I will assemble the deck and tag slides requiring Laura sign-off with SIGN-OFF flags. Draft link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcQBRDraft (I updated the cover).

Next actions: 
- Marissa: confirm Vanguard artifact handoff plan and time estimate.
- Karthik: produce slide + one-pager using the Vanguard trace once received; aim: 11/10 EOD.
- Laura: expect a SIGN-OFF cue by 11/11.

Thanks all — short replies fine.

Best,
Camila
Head of Operations
